decision.observation: Back on the lane and moving: 6 mph, gear 1, car centred on tarmac just left of a blue puddle, all six dots dark. The road runs up-screen then bends right past a barrel-and-post corridor toward a pale-lit patch. Hay bales and the dark pole are now behind on the left. A small red '+5s' icon sits beside the frozen 59:59 timer.
decision.hypothesis: The 0.7s W+A hold was the right dose from that grass pocket and remounted the lane cleanly. The lane ahead curves right, but the car is already towards the right side of it, so plain throttle should follow the bend.
decision.memory: From the grass pocket right of the lane, 0.45s steered holds stalled but 0.7s worked; the grass gap there needed the longer commit. Barrel corridors with spectators on both verges mark this part of the course.
